web/src/player/workspace/__tests__/word-matcher-detailed.test.ts › matchWordsDetailed — known false-endings (deterministic-heuristic tradeoff) DOCUMENTED NON-DETECTION: "go" vs "going" never reaches classifySubstitution at all — subScore()'s own similarity gate (lev=3 on a 5-char word fails both the lev<=1 and the lev<=2-on-4+-chars branches) rejects the pair as a substitution candidate BEFORE T7a's classifier ever runs. The aligner instead renders it as a real word-level miss (missing "go") plus an unrelated addition (extra "going") — a genuine inflection is scored as harshly as two unrelated words would be. This is a known gap in subScore's threshold, not in classifySubstitution's prefix rule, and is out of this task's scope (carry, per brief).
